from google.cloud import translate


def translate_text(text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums


def check_safety(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    annotations = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document).document_sentiment
    return annotations.score > -0.2

from google.cloud import language


def summarize_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    summary = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document).document_sentiment.text
    return summary

from google.cloud import language


def embed_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    embedding = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document).document_sentiment.score
    return embedding
